  "passage_integrity": true,
  "passage_answerability": true,
  "meaningfully_distinct": true,
  "evidence_ids": ["E1.1", "E2.1"],
  "reasons": [
    "Statement 1 directly paraphrases NCERT textbook text: management is dynamic because an organisation interacts with external factors and must adapt its goals to the environment.",
    "Statement 2 contradicts NCERT principles: while management is intangible, its effect is noticeable in an organisation where targets are met and orderliness prevails."
  ],
  "syllabus_chapter": "Nature & Significance of Management",
  "syllabus_topic": "Characteristics of management",
  "syllabus_entitlement": true,
  "presentation_ready": true,
  "question_type_match": true,
  "principle_applicability": "excerpt_required",
  "decisive_principle_in_excerpts": true,
  "answer_conditions": [
    {
      "condition": "Statement 1 accurately reflects the dynamic characteristic of management.",
      "status": "explicit",
      "alters_key_if_changed": true,
      "convention_evidence_ids": []
    },
    {
      "condition": "Statement 2 is evaluated against the textbook definition of management as an intangible force whose effect is noticeable.",
      "status": "convention",
      "alters_key_if_changed": true,
      "convention_evidence_ids": ["E2.1"]
    }
  ],
  "option_challenges": [
    {
      "option": "A",
      "strongest_reading": "Management cannot be seen, so its effect can never be noticed, while Statement 1 is false.",
      "correct_under_reading": false,
      "reading_status": "contradicts_stem",
      "convention_evidence_ids": []
    },
    {
      "option": "C",
      "strongest_reading": "Both statements are factually correct descriptions of management.",
      "correct_under_reading": false,
      "reading_status": "contradicts_stem",
      "convention_evidence_ids": []
    },
    {
      "option": "D",
      "strongest_reading": "Statement 1 is incorrect because organisations do not adapt goals to external environments.",
      "correct_under_reading": false,
      "reading_status": "contradicts_stem",
      "convention_evidence_ids": []
    }
  ],
  "blocking_defects": [],
  "style_notes": [],
  "cuet_fit": {
    "criteria": {
      "syllabus_objective": {
        "level": 3,
        "evidence": "Directly tests core characteristics of management from NCERT Unit I."
      },
      "format_authenticity": {
        "level": 3,
        "evidence": "Two-statement evaluation format is standard in CUET UG Business Studies."
      },
      "level_calibration": {
        "level": 3,
        "evidence": "Standard recall and conceptual comprehension calibrated to CUET UG difficulty."
      },
      "discrimination_value": {
        "level": 3,
        "evidence": "Distinguishes candidates who know that being intangible does not prevent management's effects from being noticed."
      }
    },
    "reasoning_steps": 2,
    "estimated_difficulty": "easy",
    "cognitive_level": "comprehension",
    "exemplar_ids_compared": ["cuet2024-business_studies-bookA-q40"]
  },
  "option_resolution": [
    {
      "option": "A",
      "status": "contradicted",
      "false_part": "Only Statement 2 is correct.",
      "premise_source": "excerpt",
      "evidence_id": "E2.1",
      "premise_quote": "The effect of management is noticeable in an organisation where targets are met according to plans, employees are happy and satisfied, and there is orderliness instead of chaos.",
      "reason": "Statement 2 is false as the effect of management is noticeable."
    },
    {
      "option": "B",
      "status": "supported",
      "false_part": "",
      "premise_source": "excerpt",
      "evidence_id": "E1.1",
      "premise_quote": "In order to be successful, an organisation must change itself and its goals according to the needs of the environment.",
      "reason": "Statement 1 is correct and Statement 2 is incorrect."
    },
    {
      "option": "C",
      "status": "contradicted",
      "false_part": "Both Statements 1 and 2 are correct.",
      "premise_source": "excerpt",
      "evidence_id": "E2.1",
      "premise_quote": "The effect of management is noticeable in an organisation where targets are met according to plans, employees are happy and satisfied, and there is orderliness instead of chaos.",
      "reason": "Statement 2 is false."
    },
    {
      "option": "D",
      "status": "contradicted",
      "false_part": "Neither Statement 1 nor Statement 2 is correct.",
      "premise_source": "excerpt",
      "evidence_id": "E1.1",
      "premise_quote": "In order to be successful, an organisation must change itself and its goals according to the needs of the environment.",
      "reason": "Statement 1 is correct."
    }
  ]
}
